poly-will-douard-philippe-win-the-2027-f.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Édouard Philippe, Emmanuel Macron's prime minister from 2020 to 2022 and founder of the Horizons party, wins France's 2027 presidential election, the first Macron cannot contest.
poly-will-douard-philippe-win-the-2027-f.recent: Philippe's price slid after an Ifop poll put Le Pen at 32-36% and Mélenchon at 17-19.5%, with the centre stalled behind both. France elects its president in two rounds, so a centrist who trails both flanks in the first never reaches the run-off, where centrist votes would decide the result.

poly-houthis-enter-aden-by-december-31-2.standing: A Polymarket contract paying out if Houthi forces enter Aden, the southern port where Yemen's internationally recognised government sits, by the end of 2026. Its price is what traders bet on the war's front reaching the south.
poly-houthis-enter-aden-by-december-31-2.recent: Betting climbed after Yemen government forces withdrew from near the Bab el-Mandeb Strait and left the Houthis holding that coast. The Saudi-led coalition answered with strikes on 60 Houthi military sites and on Hodeidah, yet Houthi forces went on to close on Aden, where residents who fled Houthi rule once were preparing to flee again.

poly-will-puma-shen-win-the-next-taipei-.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Puma Shen, a Democratic Progressive Party legislator, becomes mayor of Taipei. The capital's mayoralty has been a springboard to Taiwan's presidency, and the KMT has held it for most terms.

poly-will-the-south-african-reserve-bank.standing: What traders on Polymarket pay for the South African Reserve Bank raising its repo rate, the rate it lends to banks at, by a quarter point in January. South African prime lending rates on mortgages and car loans move with it.
poly-will-the-south-african-reserve-bank.recent: The Reserve Bank held in Pretoria, but 3 of 7 rate-setters voted to hike from 7.25%, so one switched vote turns January into a rise. Fed minutes showing almost all officials expect more rate hikes, after US consumer prices rose 0.4% in October, add pressure to follow.

wiki-bitcoin.standing: The Wikipedia article on bitcoin, the first cryptocurrency: a digital currency capped at 21 million coins and recorded on a public ledger that no bank or government controls.
wiki-bitcoin.recent: Bitcoin fell seven straight weeks, losing 29% since early October, and broke below $60,000 as rate hikes were priced in and BlackRock's bitcoin fund posted a record $541 million outflow. Then Strategy's enterprise value fell below the worth of its 851,305 bitcoin, souring Saylor's bet that the company would always trade above its coins.

poly-will-dominique-de-villepin-be-on-th.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Dominique de Villepin, Jacques Chirac's former prime minister, makes the first-round ballot of France's 2027 presidential election. Getting on it takes 500 sponsorships from elected officials.
poly-will-dominique-de-villepin-be-on-th.recent: Traders bid the contract up when Villepin, who opposed the Iraq war, declared he is running for president. Declaring settles whether he wants a place on the ballot, not whether he secures one, and nothing reported since accounts for the partial pullback.

stocks:005930.KS.standing: South Korea's largest company and one of the world's biggest makers of memory chips, alongside phones and displays. It is the heaviest weight in the Kospi, so its share moves with the global chip cycle and drags the market with it.
stocks:005930.KS.recent: Samsung fell with chipmakers across Asia in an AI selloff: on Nov 20 it and SK Hynix dragged the Kospi down more than 5%, and the following Wednesday Taiwan's Taiex fell as much as 7.9% as the same doubts about AI hit the region's chip stocks.

stocks:000660.KS.standing: One of the world's two largest makers of memory chips, based in South Korea and part of the SK Group. Its high-bandwidth memory sits beside the processors in AI data centres, so its shares trade as a bet on AI spending.
stocks:000660.KS.recent: The fall came with doubts over AI spending, the demand behind the memory SK Hynix sells: it and Samsung dragged the Kospi down more than 5% on 20 November, and the sell-off spread through Asia, where Taiwan's Taiex lost as much as 7.9%. It came as SK Hynix raced around the clock to finish its first fab at Yongin.

stocks:1211.HK.standing: China's biggest-selling carmaker, building battery-electric and plug-in hybrid cars and the batteries inside them. Its Hong Kong shares trade on the price war at home and the tariff walls its exports meet abroad.
stocks:1211.HK.recent: BYD's own news over the fortnight was mostly expansion. It entered exclusive talks to buy INEOS Automotive's Hambach plant in France, which would be its first passenger-car plant in Western Europe, and launched a third-generation Tang EV with steer-by-wire. It also shrank its bet on India. None of it accounts for the fall in its shares.

poly-will-ai-solve-the-riemann-hypothesi.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if an AI system is credited with solving the Riemann Hypothesis, the 1859 conjecture about how prime numbers are distributed and among mathematics' most famous open problems, before 2026 ends.
poly-will-ai-solve-the-riemann-hypothesi.recent: The contract repriced when the proof assistant Lean verified an AI-assisted proof of the Riemann hypothesis, with the software checking the argument before human mathematicians had read it. Traders are now betting on whether a machine-checked proof counts as the problem being solved, and whether the AI's share of the work is enough to settle the contract.

wiki-houthi-movement.standing: Ansar Allah, the Zaidi Shia armed movement from Yemen's far north that has held the capital Sanaa since 2014. Aligned with Iran, it fights a Saudi-led coalition and can reach shipping through the Red Sea.
wiki-houthi-movement.recent: The Houthis claimed a strike on Saudi Arabia's largest refinery at Ras Tanura, told workers at Jeddah's port to evacuate, and closed on Aden after taking the Bab el-Mandeb coast. Riyadh's tallest tower was hit twice in 5 days, and Pakistan, meeting Makkah Pact allies in Islamabad, called any threat to Saudi Arabia its own.

wiki-federal-reserve.standing: Daily readers of the Wikipedia article on the Federal Reserve, the US central bank. It sets the overnight rate that dollar borrowing worldwide is priced from, so its decisions reach mortgages, currencies and gold.
wiki-federal-reserve.recent: US consumer prices rose 0.4% in October, beating forecasts, and Deutsche Bank began expecting Fed hikes; the minutes then showed almost all officials expect more. Goolsbee left a larger rise open for December, and the Fed opened a probe into Bowman addressing bankers the day after a rate vote.

poly-alice-huang-federally-charged-by-de.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if US federal prosecutors charge Alice Huang before the end of 2026. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it moves on reporting about any inquiry into her.
poly-alice-huang-federally-charged-by-de.recent: A report out of Washington said Alice Huang kept a Chinese intelligence contact, tying the case to Beijing. It described no charge, indictment or step by prosecutors, and nothing else in the fortnight's news accounts for where this contract trades.

poly-will-anthropics-valuation-hit-high-.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Anthropic, the AI lab behind Claude, is valued at $1.75 trillion or more by Dec 31. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome.
poly-will-anthropics-valuation-hit-high-.recent: Anthropic slipped 1.4% on the Monday that Nvidia added nearly $1 trillion. That was the one story in the input on the company's own price, and on its own it does not account for how far traders have marked down the bet.

stocks:0100.HK.standing: Shanghai-based developer of large language and video-generation models, listed in Hong Kong. It is one of the Chinese AI startups that compete with US labs on frontier models, and it trades on how investors price that contest.
stocks:0100.HK.recent: The only news about MiniMax's own business came at the very end of the slide, when its AI recovered 94 McEliece challenge keys in a cryptography test. That result arrived after the shares had already fallen and does not account for the decline.

stocks:R3NK.DE.standing: An Augsburg maker of transmissions for tanks and armoured vehicles, plus naval and industrial gearboxes. Its order book follows European defence budgets, because most Western main battle tanks run on its drivetrains.

wiki-israel.standing: How many people read Wikipedia's article on Israel each day. Israel is a state on the eastern Mediterranean founded in 1948, and its wars and coalition politics regularly draw readers from far outside the region.
wiki-israel.recent: Since mid-November, Likud's coalition talks with Eisenkot's Yashar collapsed over Itamar Ben-Gvir, judges told prosecutors a Netanyahu bribery conviction is unlikely, and Israel launched central Gaza's first large operation since the ceasefire as the Board of Peace warned the truce faces collapse. None of it reaches back to the late-October peak.

stocks:ETL.PA.standing: A Paris-listed satellite operator that owns OneWeb, a low-orbit broadband constellation, alongside an older fleet of geostationary satellites. It is Europe's main rival to Starlink, so government and defence demand drives its shares.
stocks:ETL.PA.recent: Eutelsat won a contract with the US Space Force for service over its OneWeb network. The deal builds on hardware the Pentagon already has in place: the US military owns more than 500 OneWeb terminals.

stocks:BBIO.standing: A Palo Alto biotech that develops drugs for diseases caused by a single faulty gene. Its revenue rests on acoramidis, sold as Attruby for a transthyretin heart disease, so each new approval changes what the company is worth.
stocks:BBIO.recent: The FDA approved BridgeBio's drug for limb-girdle dystrophy, the first treatment for the disease, and the company puts the number of US patients who qualify at 2,000 to 3,000. The approval landed after the shares had already climbed, and nothing reported earlier in the month accounts for that rise.

poly-will-oborevwori-sheriff-francis-oro.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Sheriff Oborevwori, the sitting governor, wins Delta State's 2027 governorship election in Nigeria. Delta is an oil-producing Niger Delta state with one of the country's largest state budgets.
poly-will-oborevwori-sheriff-francis-oro.recent: Ovie Omo-Agege's campaign for the Delta seat says gunmen killed 4 of its supporters in Uduere. Separately, Nigeria's electoral commission blamed 54 officials for fake voter records. Both came after the bettors' climb had already happened, and nothing reported in the window explains the rise itself.

stocks:1810.HK.standing: A Beijing-based maker of smartphones and home electronics that began selling electric cars in 2024, listed in Hong Kong. Its shares now trade on how fast the car business grows against thin phone margins.
stocks:1810.HK.recent: Xiaomi's Q3 results showed memory costs eating into its profit, and phone shipments fell 29% to 30.7 million. Its cars went on presale in the UAE through dealer Gargash Prime Automotive before any official launch abroad. The SU7 is priced at $46,260 there, a test of export demand in a market without EU-style tariffs, ahead of Europe.

stocks:INSM.standing: A New Jersey drugmaker built around rare lung diseases: an inhaled antibiotic for a chronic mycobacterial infection, and a pill for bronchiectasis, a scarring of the airways that had no approved treatment before it.
stocks:INSM.recent: Sanofi offered $41bn for the company, 46% above its price before the deal leaked and the largest pharma deal of the year. Sanofi is buying two marketed medicines and a respiratory pipeline as its own patents near expiry, purchasing US revenue rather than discovering it.

stocks:SNY.standing: Sanofi's Nasdaq-listed shares. The Paris-based drugmaker's biggest seller is the eczema and asthma drug Dupixent, and it is also one of the world's largest makers of flu vaccines.
stocks:SNY.recent: Sanofi agreed to pay $41bn for the US biopharma Insmed, 46% above Insmed's pre-leak price, a deal Bloomberg read as the cost of a patent cliff: buying growth before its own drugs lose protection. The deal came after the last reading on this chart, and nothing earlier in the input explains the rise.

stocks:ADANIENT.NS.standing: The flagship of India's Adani Group, where the conglomerate builds new businesses (airports, coal mining and trading, roads, copper smelting, green hydrogen) before spinning them off as separately listed companies.
stocks:ADANIENT.NS.recent: The one story about Adani's own business, a New Delhi deal to buy 2,000 tons of recycled copper anode a month, came the day after this window closed, and none of the input accounts for the share's move before it.

stocks:TSM.standing: The New York-listed shares of TSMC, the contract chipmaker that builds most of the world's advanced processors for Apple, Nvidia and others. Its fabs sit mostly in Taiwan, so the stock carries the island's geopolitical risk.

stocks:PLTR.standing: Palantir Technologies sells data-integration and analysis software to militaries, intelligence services, police forces and large companies. Government contracts carry much of its revenue, and its richly valued shares swing hard on growth news.
stocks:PLTR.recent: Palantir registered its trademark in Argentina, and Brazil's attorney general's office began a pilot of its software, which the country's spies had rejected. Neither development accounts for the fall in the share.

poly-will-aap-win-the-most-seats-in-the-.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether the Aam Aadmi Party, which has governed Punjab since its 2022 landslide, wins the most seats in the state's next assembly election. It settles on seats won, not on who forms the government.
poly-will-aap-win-the-most-seats-in-the-.recent: The one Punjab development in the window was Akali Dal's return to Modi's alliance, the one it quit over the farm laws, which puts two of AAP's rivals back on one ticket alongside the BJP. That deal came after the contract's slide had already bottomed out, and nothing in the input accounts for the earlier fall.

poly-ilhan-omar-federally-charged-by-dec.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether federal prosecutors charge Ilhan Omar, the Democratic congresswoman from Minnesota, with a crime before the year ends. It pays out on a filed charge, not on an investigation.
poly-ilhan-omar-federally-charged-by-dec.recent: A judge made prosecutors rewrite their plan to search Ilhan Omar's home, limiting the search without any charge being filed. It is the one ruling on the investigation in the input, and nothing in it explains the earlier peak.

stocks:CSCO.standing: The biggest maker of the routers and switches that corporate networks and internet carriers run on, with a growing software arm in security and Webex. Its orders work as a gauge of how much businesses spend on IT.

stocks:6702.T.standing: Fujitsu, Japan's largest IT services company, listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. It builds and runs government and corporate systems, and its share price tracks Japanese public-sector and enterprise spending on digital work.

stocks:MSI.standing: The US maker of the two-way radio networks, dispatch software and video security that police, fire and ambulance services run on. Most of its revenue comes from governments, on long contracts that rarely switch supplier.

stocks:TMUS.standing: T-Mobile US, one of the three national wireless carriers in the United States, majority-owned by Germany's Deutsche Telekom. Its share price tracks how many phone and home-internet subscribers it can win from Verizon and AT&T.

poly-will-the-reserve-bank-of-australia-.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays if the Reserve Bank of Australia leaves its cash rate unchanged at the February meeting. That overnight rate sets borrowing costs across Australia, where most home loans float with it.
poly-will-the-reserve-bank-of-australia-.recent: Annual inflation in Australia reached 4.9% even after 125 basis points of RBA hikes, and the Aussie jumped on the CPI print. A figure that hot keeps another rise in play and makes a February pause a less certain bet. The run of Fed hike talk in Washington the same fortnight is about US prices, not Sydney's.

wiki-united-states.standing: Daily readers of the English Wikipedia article on the United States, a federal republic of 50 states and the world's largest economy. Readers come in waves when an American election, war or policy decision reaches beyond its borders.
wiki-united-states.recent: The past fortnight's news from Washington ran to Sean Duffy's demand for $50 billion after air travel chaos, Nvidia's board reinstating Jensen Huang, and Trump's call to investigate a 4.3% growth revision; none of it falls on the peak, which came earlier in the month.

stocks:WMT.standing: The world's largest retailer by revenue, running discount stores and Sam's Club warehouses across the US and owning most of India's Flipkart. Its sales track what lower- and middle-income American households spend.
stocks:WMT.recent: Its Indian arm Flipkart said chief executive Kalyan Krishnamurthy leaves on 4 December after 11 years, with a successor expected soon. That news broke after the rise and does not account for it.

stocks:ETSY.standing: An online marketplace for handmade, vintage and craft goods, where small independent sellers reach buyers. It earns from listing, transaction and advertising fees, so it rises and falls with discretionary consumer spending.
stocks:ETSY.recent: The one story about Etsy's own business came after the decline, not before it. New terms appeared to let it train AI on sellers' artwork, and after a backlash CEO Kruti Patel Goyal 'clarified' them, while sellers closed shops of 13 and 15 years. Nothing in the input accounts for the earlier fall.

stocks:MBG.DE.standing: The Stuttgart maker of Mercedes-Benz cars and vans, listed in Frankfurt and a member of Germany's DAX. Its profits lean on luxury models and on China, so its shares track demand from wealthy buyers there and trade policy.
stocks:MBG.DE.recent: In Guangzhou, Mercedes launched a hybrid CLA running ByteDance's Doubao AI, a German car sold in China on Chinese software. The launch came after the late-November trough, and nothing reported about the company's own business accounts for the earlier slide.

stocks:2222.SR.standing: Saudi Arabia's state oil producer and the world's largest crude exporter, listed on the Saudi Exchange since 2019 with only a sliver of its shares floated. Its dividend is one of the main sources of the kingdom's budget.
stocks:2222.SR.recent: The Yemeni military named Aramco its prime target in Saudi Arabia, and on Wednesday the Houthis claimed a strike on Ras Tanura, Saudi Arabia's largest refinery, sending black smoke over the site. Neither the threat nor the attack accounts for the share's earlier climb.

stocks:BILI.standing: A Shanghai-based video platform that grew out of anime and gaming fan culture and is popular with young Chinese viewers. It earns from mobile games, advertising, live streaming and paid memberships.

stocks:ASML.standing: The Dutch maker of the lithography machines that print circuits onto silicon, and the only supplier of the extreme-ultraviolet tools the most advanced chips need. Export rules on its sales to China shape its order book.
stocks:ASML.recent: The fall came in a wider AI chip sell-off, not from news of ASML's own business. This week Christophe Fouquet argued that export controls should guard the leading edge without cutting China off, warning that full decoupling backfires, in a market where ASML holds close to 100%.

stocks:1024.HK.standing: Kuaishou runs one of China's two dominant short-video and livestreaming apps, the main rival to ByteDance's Douyin. It earns from advertising, livestream tipping and e-commerce, and also builds the Kling AI video model.
stocks:1024.HK.recent: Kuaishou reported record users but an 11.1% fall in revenue, as free short dramas squeezed the platforms that once charged for them. A week earlier it had doubled down on Kling, whose earnings of over $20 million in December 2025 alone are the company's case that the AI bet can offset a shrinking core.

stocks:WB.standing: China's largest microblogging platform, listed on Nasdaq and controlled by Sina. Nearly all its revenue is advertising, so its share price tracks Chinese consumer spending and Beijing's rules on online content.

stocks:BEZQ.TA.standing: Israel's largest telecommunications group and its former state monopoly, running the national fixed-line and broadband network alongside the Pelephone mobile carrier and the yes satellite TV service.

stocks:BCS.standing: A British universal bank headquartered in London, running a high-street lender at home alongside a large investment bank on Wall Street. Its shares, listed in London and New York, move with UK interest rates and trading revenue.

stocks:C.standing: Citigroup is one of the largest US banks, headquartered in New York, and the most international of them. Its share price is a read on global corporate banking and on the cross-border payments it handles for multinationals.

stocks:300750.SZ.standing: Shares of Contemporary Amperex Technology, the Ningde-based maker of lithium-ion cells that power a large share of the world's electric cars and grid batteries. Its order book tracks EV sales in China and abroad.
stocks:300750.SZ.recent: The fall took CATL's market value below a trillion yuan, to 964 billion, and that is 54% lower than in May. Behind it were a production cut and weaker demand for its batteries.

stocks:NAS.OL.standing: Norway's largest airline, a low-cost carrier flying short-haul routes across the Nordics and Europe, which also owns the regional airline Widerøe. Its shares move on jet fuel prices, the krone and summer travel demand.

stocks:AMER3.SA.standing: A Brazilian retailer selling through hundreds of stores and an online marketplace, listed in São Paulo. It entered judicial recovery in 2023 after an accounting fraud hid billions of reais of debt.

stocks:CBK.DE.standing: One of Germany's largest private-sector banks, based in Frankfurt and a main lender to the country's mid-sized exporters. The German state has held a stake in it since rescuing it in the 2008 financial crisis.
stocks:CBK.DE.recent: The weeks were taken up by UniCredit's €45 billion bid: the EU approved it unconditionally, UniCredit then said it would make its own chief executive, Andrea Orcel, Commerzbank's chair, and Germany backed that board overhaul. None of it explains why the shares fell while the takeover advanced.

stocks:BCP.BK.standing: A Thai oil refiner and fuel retailer listed on the Stock Exchange of Thailand. It runs a refinery inside Bangkok and one of the country's largest chains of petrol stations, so its earnings ride on refining margins and the crude price.
stocks:BCP.BK.recent: An explosion at Bangchak's refinery in Bangkok injured seven people, four of them critically, and forced an evacuation of the surrounding neighbourhood. The blast came at the end of a slide that had already run for weeks, and nothing reported in the fortnight before it accounts for the earlier fall.

stocks:INDI.standing: A fabless chip designer in Aliso Viejo, California, selling sensing and processing chips for driver assistance, radar, cameras and in-cabin electronics. Its sales rise and fall with carmakers' production and model launches.

stocks:HO.PA.standing: France's defence electronics group, making radars, air-defence missiles, avionics, secure communications and, with Leonardo, satellites. The French state is its biggest shareholder, and European defence budgets reach its order book.
stocks:HO.PA.recent: Thales Alenia Space plans to spin out a company, open to private investors, to build and sell cargo return from space stations, Italian unions FIM, FIOM and UILM disclosed. Europe relies on SpaceX's Dragon to bring cargo back from orbit. The plan surfaced after the share's last close, so it does not account for the price.

poly-will-psoe-win-the-most-seats-in-the.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays if the Spanish Socialist Workers' Party wins the most seats in Spain's Congress of Deputies at the next general election. Its main rival for first place is the conservative People's Party.

stocks:000002.SZ.standing: One of China's largest homebuilders, listed in Shenzhen and part-owned by the city's state-run metro operator. Its debts are read as a test of whether Beijing will let a state-linked developer default.
stocks:000002.SZ.recent: Vanke went back to its bondholders in Shenzhen asking them to push repayment out by another 3 years. It is the second time it has sought an extension, so the developer still cannot meet what it owes on the original schedule, and shareholders sit behind those creditors.

stocks:DIS.standing: The entertainment group behind the Disney and Pixar film studios, the ABC television network, ESPN, the Disney+ streaming service and theme parks on three continents. Parks and cruises earn most of its operating profit.
stocks:DIS.recent: The one story here about Disney's own business, a federal judge barring the FCC from an early licence review of eight ABC stations, came the day after this window closes, so nothing in the input explains the rise.

stocks:LI.standing: Shares of Li Auto, a Beijing carmaker that built its brand on large family SUVs with a petrol range extender. It is one of the few Chinese electric-car startups to turn a profit, and a test of whether that model survives a price war.
stocks:LI.recent: Battery-electric cars passed 50% of Li Auto sales, a turn away from the extended-range models it was built on, but that news landed a day after the latest close. No other report from the fortnight concerns the company's own business, so none of it accounts for the share's swing.

poly-netanyahu-out-before-2027-684-719-2.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Benjamin Netanyahu is no longer Israel's prime minister by the end of 2026. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it moves on coalition arithmetic and election timing.
poly-netanyahu-out-before-2027-684-719-2.recent: The buying gathered pace as the opposition consolidated. Gadi Eisenkot signed a deal with the Democrats that gave his bloc 48 of 120 seats, and the contract peaked the day after.

poly-us-x-iran-effective-ceasefire-by-de.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the United States and Iran agree a ceasefire by December 31. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it moves on talks, strikes and the state of the Strait of Hormuz.
poly-us-x-iran-effective-ceasefire-by-de.recent: The rise followed diplomacy coming into the open: Doha began reviving Iran-US talks, and US envoy Jared Kushner then confirmed meetings with Iranian officials. The fighting around Hormuz went on meanwhile. Mines hit tankers, US aircraft disabled the Pacific Archer, and an Iranian drone killed 2 Italian technicians in Kuwait.

stocks:DELL.standing: Dell Technologies, the Texas maker of PCs, servers and storage, listed in New York. Its servers built around Nvidia chips have made it one of the main ways money spent on AI data centres reaches a hardware seller.
stocks:DELL.recent: Dell reported a record $132.3 billion backlog of AI orders, and the shares fell anyway. Server makers are caught in a margin squeeze: a larger book of AI machines did not mean more profit on each one sold.

stocks:SMCI.standing: Super Micro Computer, a San Jose maker of servers and storage, assembles racks of AI machines built around Nvidia chips. Its share trades on how fast data centres are being built and on the supply of those chips.

wiki-petroleum.standing: Crude oil and the fuels refined from it, the most traded commodity on earth. Its price runs into transport, plastics, fertiliser and power bills, and into the budgets of the states that pump it.
wiki-petroleum.recent: A fuel tanker crashed in Cairo and the fire killed at least 31, and a refinery blast in Bangkok left seven injured. OPEC+ delegates weighed rolling output quotas into January while Iraq pressed for a higher share, a day after Iraq's top court ruled the government can take over Kurdish oil fields.

poly-h100-average-rental-price-in-januar.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Ornn's index of the hourly cost of renting one Nvidia H100 GPU tops $2.80 in January 2027. H100 rents are the going price of AI compute and show how tight training capacity is.

poly-will-puma-shen-win-the-2026-taipei-.standing: A Polymarket contract on Taipei's mayoral race that pays only if Puma Shen, a Democratic Progressive Party legislator, wins by eight points or more, a high bar in a capital that has not elected a DPP mayor since 1998.

poly-b300-average-rental-price-in-januar.standing: A bet on whether the average hourly price to rent an Nvidia B300, the chipmaker's top AI accelerator, will exceed $12 in January 2027 by Ornn's compute price index. It tracks how scarce frontier AI computing power is.

stocks:IMB.L.standing: A London-listed tobacco maker and one of the world's largest, selling cigarettes, cigars, fine-cut tobacco and vapes across Europe, the US and Africa. Its shares trade on the cash it returns to shareholders as smoking declines.
stocks:IMB.L.recent: Altria said it may bid for Imperial Brands, and Japan Tobacco surfaced as a second possible suitor, sending the shares up 13.3% in a day. The prospect of a contest that would consolidate Big Tobacco lifted Japan Tobacco's own shares too.

stocks:MO.standing: America's largest tobacco company and the US owner of Marlboro, which also sells nicotine pouches and e-cigarettes and holds a stake in brewer AB InBev. Its high dividend makes it a staple of income portfolios.
stocks:MO.recent: Altria said it may bid for Britain's Imperial Brands, whose shares jumped 13.3%, with Japan Tobacco also circling and a Christmas Eve deadline under UK takeover rules. It may sell its AB InBev stake to pay. The announcement came after the last close shown, so it does not account for the window's move.

wiki-gold.standing: Daily reads of Wikipedia's article on gold, the metal central banks hold in reserve and households across Asia and the Muslim world keep savings in. It shows when the price or the mining of it reaches people beyond trading desks.
wiki-gold.recent: Gold broke below $3,500 for the first time since September 2025, more than a third under January's $5,447 peak. An AI-stock selloff forced investors to sell bullion to meet margin calls, and bets on a Fed rate hike raised the cost of holding it. In Indonesia, floodwater filled an illegal gold mine near Bogor, killing 13.

stocks:SAP.standing: Germany's largest software company, based in Walldorf, whose systems run the accounts, payroll and supply chains of most of the world's largest firms. This line is its share as listed in New York, priced in dollars.
stocks:SAP.recent: SAP confirmed a cyber incident on 2026-11-27 after reports that hackers reached its GitHub development infrastructure and may have taken source code. That news broke two days after this chart ends, so it does not account for the November slide, and nothing else in the input explains it.

stocks:INTC.standing: The American company that designs the x86 processors inside most PCs and servers and, unlike most rivals, makes them in its own factories. It is Washington's main bet on building leading-edge chips at home.
stocks:INTC.recent: Ars Technica reconstructed how Intel's board, after finding the terms unattractive, signed over a 10% equity stake to the Trump administration to unlock CHIPS Act grants it had already been promised. The account explains who now owns part of the company, not the fall in its share.

poly-will-huang-shih-chieh-win-the-next-.standing: The price of a contract that pays out if Huang Shih-chieh wins the mayoralty of Taoyuan, one of Taiwan's six special municipalities and home to its main international airport. It is what traders bet, not a forecast.

poly-b200-average-rental-price-in-decemb.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Ornn's benchmark rental price for Nvidia's B200 data-centre GPU tops $9.60 in December 2026. It is a bet on how scarce AI compute stays, which sets what labs and startups pay to train models.

poly-will-marco-rubio-win-the-2028-repub.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Marco Rubio, the US secretary of state, wins the Republican presidential nomination in 2028. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome against the rest of the field.

poly-jensen-huang-announced-resignation-.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Jensen Huang, Nvidia's co-founder and only chief executive since 1993, leaves the job before the end of 2026. A change at the top of the dominant AI chipmaker would reach every lab that buys its chips.

stocks:MU.standing: An American maker of memory chips, DRAM and NAND flash, and one of three firms that make most of the world's DRAM. Its high-bandwidth memory sits beside AI accelerators, so its share swings with data-centre spending.

poly-will-josh-shapiro-win-the-2028-demo.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Josh Shapiro, the Pennsylvania Democrat first elected governor in 2022, wins his party's 2028 presidential nomination. It prices a swing-state governor's standing in an open field.

stocks:HPE.standing: The business half of the old Hewlett-Packard, split off in 2015. It sells servers, storage and networking gear to companies and governments, and its AI systems built on Nvidia chips put it in direct competition with Dell.

poly-russia-x-ukraine-energy-ceasefire-a.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Russia and Ukraine agree, before 2026 ends, to stop striking each other's power plants, grids and refineries. Those strikes decide Ukraine's winter heating and Russia's fuel exports.
poly-russia-x-ukraine-energy-ceasefire-a.recent: Both sides spent the fortnight hitting energy rather than sparing it: Ukrainian drones cut Russian refining 45%, industry sources estimate, and Putin vowed retaliation after promising 'much more painful' strikes. Kyiv's truce offer covers only the Black Sea and its grain, and Washington's deadline for a wider deal is January 2027.

stocks:AAPL.standing: The share of Apple, maker of the iPhone and owner of the App Store. Most of its revenue comes from the iPhone, so the stock moves on handset demand, on App Store fees, and on trade rules between the US and China, where most iPhones are assembled.
stocks:AAPL.recent: OpenAI answered Apple's June trade-secrets suit with a countersuit alleging Apple bars its hardware suppliers from working with OpenAI. Apple also blamed an internal update for an outage across its services and joined the race for AI agents that control a device. None of it explains the share's rise.
